newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania OTC market heavyweights lose ground.
newsitem.headline: Romania OTC market heavyweights lose ground.

text.p: Romania's over-the-counter (OTC) market fell on Wednesday as oil refineries and cement makers recoiled after gains in previous sessions, traders said.

Independent indices VAB-RASDAQ and BIG-OTC inched down by 1.7 and 2.73 percent respectively from the previous session to 3,992.64 and 3,158.81 points, but traders said they expected a gradual recovery in the next few sessions.
"We thought there was room for already high prices to rise some more but heavyweights had apparently hit a resistance level," one trader said.
Oil refineries, metallurgical listings and some of the cement makers on the market -- all stars of the previous trading day -- closed weaker on Wednesday.
Cement maker Moldocim, a gainer on Tuesday, ended 12,500 lei weaker at 40,000, while another cement maker, Casial, closed 150 lei down at 2,400. Romcim gained 2,000 lei at 63,000 lei.
Oil refinery Arpechim closed 18,500 lei down at 34,000 lei, while steel plant Sidex Galati drifted down 6,000 lei to close at 21,500.
Volumes on the RASDAQ, the Romanian OTC market, rose slightly to 2.25 million from 2.08 million previously, while turnover fell to 9.82 billion lei from 12.89 billion. ($=7,097 lei)
